5f387c94112a.text: HEK293 culture depends on controlled medium, temperature and gas conditions. That dependence supports a contained laboratory platform; it is not evidence that escaped cells are instantly nonviable or that release has zero risk. Our current safety case relies on physical containment, trained handling and verified waste inactivation, not on an engineered kill switch.
